brief.scope: Adjudicate original Claude CHANGES at 77419ab against that exact composite and original report only. No later fixes/concessions. Rule all three findings: repeated commit-message assembly defect, missing original INVALID/review records in snapshot, and residual frontend wording. Distinguish source-only document acceptance from conductor archive custody and the incumbent message-builder defect. The candidate has been published: do not prescribe rewriting its history; give a prospective reproducible repair preserving original messages/records. Do not broaden into runtime implementation or silently waive a gate. Read process/wire contracts, measure exact refs and original producer body. Return UPHELD/PARTIAL/REJECTED per finding and bounded ownership with valid review envelope. No edits, full floor, live state or vendor.

findings.claim: PARTIAL. Defect UPHELD as the incumbent launcher message-builder, not as a contract-file defect and not as producer text. git log -1 --format='%(trailers:only)' and git interpret-trailers --parse on 77419ab both emit a third trailer `pass: 100 checks, 51 local links and six JSON examples. The original 83` between Source: original and Co-Authored-By: gpt-6-astra, the same slot as Validation: on eeb16185. House form at 3f84832, b15f690 and 83706c9 is a two-line Source/Co-Authored-By block. The producer body in 2b5149 is well-formed: paragraph two keeps `pass: 100 checks, 51 local links and six JSON examples. Preserve the original 83 disposition instructions...` in prose, and interpret-trailers --parse on that body yields only Source and Co-Authored-By. REJECTED as a history-rewrite of the published candidate: do not amend 77419ab or eeb16185, and do not re-assemble this SHA from the producer body. Prospective repair, preserving original messages: (1) fix the launcher builder so a `Token:` line inside producer prose is not moved into the trailer block, and do that before any successor docs commit, or the successor repeats the defect; (2) on the next docs commit, name 77419ab's displaced `pass:` line as a historical formatting defect, the same way 77419ab named eeb16185's split Validation: sentence; (3) keep 2b5149 commit.body as the original producer message. Source-only acceptance of the two CONTRACT.md blobs is independent of this builder defect.

findings.claim: UPHELD. Residual frontend wording in the owned documents. dispatch:61 still reads `Frontends retain launch's exit and stderr refusal detail, stdout record acknowledgement record: <id>, and canonical record as their result source.` Consuming-versus-refusing is applied at :27-28 (`Consuming frontends preserve...`; `Task owns its vendor-mode invalid envelope... its vendor refusal returns no launch result`) and not at :61. task:221-230: vendor-mode run returns the invalid envelope before snapshot, render, adapter lookup, process creation or store access; the CLI prints it and exits 2; it never invokes launch, so it retains no launch exit, stderr refusal detail, `record: <id>`, or canonical record. Frontend table :25 lists task run as a frontend. :71 names `task CLI 0/1/2/64` later and does not qualify :61. This is a document-wording residual, not a runtime implementation. Prospective repair on a successor docs commit (do not amend 77419ab): `Consuming frontends retain launch's exit...` at :61. No other document change follows. This is the only finding against the two CONTRACT.md files; source-only acceptance of 77419ab as parent of that one-word successor is allowed.
